name: Erdos1153.continuous_lebesgueFunction

name: Erdos1153.exists_lebesgueOn_eq_and_ge
statement:
lemma exists_lebesgueOn_eq_and_ge {n : ℕ} (nodes : NodeFamily n) {a b : ℝ}
    (hab : a ≤ b) :
    ∃ t ∈ Set.Icc a b,
      lebesgueOn nodes a b = lebesgueFunction nodes t ∧
        ∀ u ∈ Set.Icc a b, lebesgueFunction nodes u ≤ lebesgueFunction nodes t

name: Erdos1153.lagrangeBasis_eq_product
statement:
lemma lagrangeBasis_eq_product {n : ℕ} (nodes : NodeFamily n) (k : Fin n) :
    lagrangeBasis nodes k =
      ∏ i ∈ Finset.univ.erase k,
        (Polynomial.X - Polynomial.C (nodes.point i)) *
          Polynomial.C (nodes.point k - nodes.point i)⁻¹

name: Erdos1153.lagrangeBasis_eval
statement:
lemma lagrangeBasis_eval {n : ℕ} (nodes : NodeFamily n) (k : Fin n) (t : ℝ) :
    (lagrangeBasis nodes k).eval t = lagrangeFundamental nodes k t

name: Erdos1153.lagrangeBasis_eval_of_ne

name: Erdos1153.lagrangeBasis_eval_self
statement:
@[simp]
lemma lagrangeBasis_eval_self {n : ℕ} (nodes : NodeFamily n) (k : Fin n) :

name: Erdos1153.lt_lebesgueOn_iff
statement:
lemma lt_lebesgueOn_iff {n : ℕ} (nodes : NodeFamily n) {a b c : ℝ}
    (hab : a ≤ b) :
    c < lebesgueOn nodes a b ↔
      ∃ t ∈ Set.Icc a b, c < lebesgueFunction nodes t

name: Erdos1153.abs_eval_le_lebesgueFunction
statement:
lemma abs_eval_le_lebesgueFunction {n : ℕ} (nodes : NodeFamily n)
    (p : ℝ[X]) (hp : p.degree < n) (t : ℝ)
    (hp_nodes : ∀ k : Fin n, |p.eval (nodes.point k)| ≤ 1) :
    |p.eval t| ≤ lebesgueFunction nodes t

name: Erdos1153.abs_eval_le_mul_lebesgueFunction
statement:
lemma abs_eval_le_mul_lebesgueFunction {n : ℕ} (nodes : NodeFamily n)
    (p : ℝ[X]) (hp : p.degree < n) (M t : ℝ)
    (hM : ∀ k : Fin n, |p.eval (nodes.point k)| ≤ M) :
    |p.eval t| ≤ M * lebesgueFunction nodes t

name: Erdos1153.abs_eval_le_nodalMax_mul_lebesgueFunction
statement:
lemma abs_eval_le_nodalMax_mul_lebesgueFunction {n : ℕ}
    (nodes : NodeFamily n) (p : ℝ[X]) (hp : p.degree < n)
    (hn : 0 < n) (t : ℝ) :
    |p.eval t| ≤ nodalMax nodes p hn * lebesgueFunction nodes t

name: Erdos1153.abs_eval_node_le_nodalMax
statement:
lemma abs_eval_node_le_nodalMax {n : ℕ} (nodes : NodeFamily n) (p : ℝ[X])
    (hn : 0 < n) (k : Fin n) :
    |p.eval (nodes.point k)| ≤ nodalMax nodes p hn

name: Erdos1153.eval_lagrangeExpansion
statement:
lemma eval_lagrangeExpansion {n : ℕ} (nodes : NodeFamily n) (p : ℝ[X])
    (hp : p.degree < n) (t : ℝ) :
    p.eval t = ∑ k : Fin n,
      p.eval (nodes.point k) * lagrangeFundamental nodes k t

name: Erdos1153.exists_nodalMax_eq
statement:
lemma exists_nodalMax_eq {n : ℕ} (nodes : NodeFamily n) (p : ℝ[X])
    (hn : 0 < n) :
    ∃ k : Fin n, nodalMax nodes p hn = |p.eval (nodes.point k)|

name: Erdos1153.lagrangeExpansion
statement:
lemma lagrangeExpansion {n : ℕ} (nodes : NodeFamily n) (p : ℝ[X])
    (hp : p.degree < n) :
    p = ∑ k : Fin n,
      Polynomial.C (p.eval (nodes.point k)) * lagrangeBasis nodes k

name: Erdos1153.ClassicalBound.fullIntervalAt_iff_exists_point
statement:
lemma fullIntervalAt_iff_exists_point {n : ℕ} (nodes : NodeFamily n) (ε : ℝ) :
    FullIntervalAt nodes ε ↔
      ∃ t ∈ Set.Icc (-1 : ℝ) 1,
        (2 / Real.pi - ε) * Real.log (n : ℝ) < lebesgueFunction nodes t

name: Erdos1153.ClassicalBound.fullIntervalEventual_of_certificates
statement:
lemma fullIntervalEventual_of_certificates
    (hcert : ∀ ε : ℝ, 0 < ε →
      ∃ N : ℕ, ∀ n : ℕ, N ≤ n → ∀ nodes : NodeFamily n,
        PolynomialCertificate nodes
          ((2 / Real.pi - ε) * Real.log (n : ℝ))) :
    FullIntervalEventual

lemma normingPolynomial_eval_self {n : ℕ} (nodes : NodeFamily n) (t : ℝ) :

statement:
lemma polynomialCertificate_iff_exists_point {n : ℕ} (nodes : NodeFamily n) (A : ℝ) :

Erdos1153.ClassicalBound.abs_derivative_lagrangeBasis_mul_swap
statement:
lemma abs_derivative_lagrangeBasis_mul_swap {n : ℕ} (nodes : NodeFamily n)
    {j k : Fin n} (hjk : j ≠ k) :
    |(lagrangeBasis nodes k).derivative.eval (nodes.point j)| *
        |(lagrangeBasis nodes j).derivative.eval (nodes.point k)| =
      (|nodes.point j - nodes.point k| ^ 2)⁻¹

name: Erdos1153.ClassicalBound.abs_lagrangeFundamental_eq_nodalPolynomial
statement:
lemma abs_lagrangeFundamental_eq_nodalPolynomial {n : ℕ}
    (nodes : NodeFamily n) (k : Fin n) {t : ℝ}
    (htk : t ≠ nodes.point k) :
    |lagrangeFundamental nodes k t| =
      |(nodalPolynomial nodes).eval t| *
        (|(nodalPolynomial nodes).derivative.eval (nodes.point k)| *
          |t - nodes.point k|)⁻¹

name: Erdos1153.ClassicalBound.arcsine_reciprocal_mass_le_lebesgueFunction
statement:
lemma arcsine_reciprocal_mass_le_lebesgueFunction {n : ℕ}
    (nodes : NodeFamily n) (hn : 0 < n) {t M : ℝ}
    (ht : ∀ k : Fin n, t ≠ nodes.point k) (hM : 0 < M)
    (heval : |(nodalPolynomial nodes).eval t| = M)
    (hbernstein : ∀ k : Fin n,
      Real.sqrt (1 - (nodes.point k) ^ 2) *
          |(nodalPolynomial nodes).derivative.eval (nodes.point k)| ≤
        (n : ℝ) * M) :
    (n : ℝ)⁻¹ *
        ∑ k : Fin n,
          Real.sqrt (1 - (nodes.point k) ^ 2) *
            |t - nodes.point k|⁻¹ ≤
      lebesgueFunction nodes t

name: Erdos1153.ClassicalBound.arcsine_reciprocal_mass_le_lebesgueOn
statement:
lemma arcsine_reciprocal_mass_le_lebesgueOn {n : ℕ}
    (nodes : NodeFamily n) (hn : 0 < n) {t M : ℝ}
    (htIcc : t ∈ Set.Icc (-1 : ℝ) 1)
    (ht : ∀ k : Fin n, t ≠ nodes.point k) (hM : 0 < M)
    (heval : |(nodalPolynomial nodes).eval t| = M)
    (hbernstein : ∀ k : Fin n,
      Real.sqrt (1 - (nodes.point k) ^ 2) *
          |(nodalPolynomial nodes).derivative.eval (nodes.point k)| ≤
        (n : ℝ) * M) :
    (n : ℝ)⁻¹ *
        ∑ k : Fin n,
          Real.sqrt (1 - (nodes.point k) ^ 2) *
            |t - nodes.point k|⁻¹ ≤
      lebesgueOn nodes (-1) 1

name: Erdos1153.ClassicalBound.degree_nodalPolynomial
statement:
@[simp]
lemma degree_nodalPolynomial {n : ℕ} (nodes : NodeFamily n) :

name: Erdos1153.ClassicalBound.derivative_lagrangeBasis_eval_of_ne
statement:
lemma derivative_lagrangeBasis_eval_of_ne {n : ℕ} (nodes : NodeFamily n)
    {j k : Fin n} (hjk : j ≠ k) :
    (lagrangeBasis nodes k).derivative.eval (nodes.point j) =
      (nodalPolynomial nodes).derivative.eval (nodes.point j) *
        ((nodalPolynomial nodes).derivative.eval (nodes.point k))⁻¹ *
          (nodes.point j - nodes.point k)⁻¹

name: Erdos1153.ClassicalBound.derivative_lagrangeBasis_mul_swap
statement:
lemma derivative_lagrangeBasis_mul_swap {n : ℕ} (nodes : NodeFamily n)
    {j k : Fin n} (hjk : j ≠ k) :
    (lagrangeBasis nodes k).derivative.eval (nodes.point j) *
        (lagrangeBasis nodes j).derivative.eval (nodes.point k) =
      -((nodes.point j - nodes.point k) ^ 2)⁻¹

name: Erdos1153.ClassicalBound.derivative_nodalPolynomial_eval_node
statement:
lemma derivative_nodalPolynomial_eval_node {n : ℕ} (nodes : NodeFamily n)
    (k : Fin n) :
    (nodalPolynomial nodes).derivative.eval (nodes.point k) =
      ∏ j ∈ Finset.univ.erase k, (nodes.point k - nodes.point j)

Erdos1153.ClassicalBound.exists_arcsine_reciprocal_mass_le_lebesgueOn_of_rootBernstein
statement:
lemma exists_arcsine_reciprocal_mass_le_lebesgueOn_of_rootBernstein
    {n : ℕ} (nodes : NodeFamily n) (hn : 0 < n)
    (hbernstein : ∀ k : Fin n,
      Real.sqrt (1 - (nodes.point k) ^ 2) *
          |(nodalPolynomial nodes).derivative.eval (nodes.point k)| ≤
        (n : ℝ) * nodalMaximum nodes) :
    ∃ t ∈ Set.Icc (-1 : ℝ) 1,
      (∀ k : Fin n, t ≠ nodes.point k) ∧
        (n : ℝ)⁻¹ *
            ∑ k : Fin n,
              Real.sqrt (1 - (nodes.point k) ^ 2) *
                |t - nodes.point k|⁻¹ ≤
          lebesgueOn nodes (-1) 1

name: Erdos1153.ClassicalBound.exists_nodalMaximum_eq_and_ge
statement:
lemma exists_nodalMaximum_eq_and_ge {n : ℕ} (nodes : NodeFamily n) :
    ∃ t ∈ Set.Icc (-1 : ℝ) 1,
      nodalMaximum nodes = |(nodalPolynomial nodes).eval t| ∧
        ∀ u ∈ Set.Icc (-1 : ℝ) 1,
          |(nodalPolynomial nodes).eval u| ≤
            |(nodalPolynomial nodes).eval t|

name: Erdos1153.ClassicalBound.exists_nodalMaximum_eq_and_off_nodes
statement:
lemma exists_nodalMaximum_eq_and_off_nodes {n : ℕ} (nodes : NodeFamily n) :
    ∃ t ∈ Set.Icc (-1 : ℝ) 1,
      nodalMaximum nodes = |(nodalPolynomial nodes).eval t| ∧
        (∀ u ∈ Set.Icc (-1 : ℝ) 1,
          |(nodalPolynomial nodes).eval u| ≤
            |(nodalPolynomial nodes).eval t|) ∧
        ∀ k : Fin n, t ≠ nodes.point k

name: Erdos1153.ClassicalBound.lagrangeBasis_eq_C_derivative_inv_mul_nodal_erase
statement:
lemma lagrangeBasis_eq_C_derivative_inv_mul_nodal_erase {n : ℕ}
    (nodes : NodeFamily n) (k : Fin n) :
    lagrangeBasis nodes k =
      Polynomial.C
          ((nodalPolynomial nodes).derivative.eval (nodes.point k))⁻¹ *
        Lagrange.nodal (Finset.univ.erase k) nodes.point

name: Erdos1153.ClassicalBound.lagrangeFundamental_eq_nodalPolynomial_mul
statement:
lemma lagrangeFundamental_eq_nodalPolynomial_mul {n : ℕ}
    (nodes : NodeFamily n) (k : Fin n) {t : ℝ}
    (htk : t ≠ nodes.point k) :
    lagrangeFundamental nodes k t =
      (nodalPolynomial nodes).eval t *
        (((nodalPolynomial nodes).derivative.eval (nodes.point k))⁻¹ *

name: Erdos1153.ClassicalBound.lebesgueFunction_eq_nodalPolynomial_mul_sum

lemma lebesgueFunction_eq_nodalPolynomial_mul_sum {n : ℕ}

name: Erdos1153.ClassicalBound.nodalPolynomial_mul_sum_inv_le_lebesgueFunction
statement:
lemma nodalPolynomial_mul_sum_inv_le_lebesgueFunction {n : ℕ}
    (nodes : NodeFamily n) {t : ℝ}
    (ht : ∀ k : Fin n, t ≠ nodes.point k)
    (D : Fin n → ℝ) (hD : ∀ k, 0 < D k)
    (hderiv : ∀ k,
      |(nodalPolynomial nodes).derivative.eval (nodes.point k)| ≤ D k) :
    |(nodalPolynomial nodes).eval t| *
        ∑ k : Fin n, (D k * |t - nodes.point k|)⁻¹ ≤
      lebesgueFunction nodes t

name: Erdos1153.ClassicalBound.abs_lagrangeFundamental_mul_distance_eq_pair_transport
statement:
lemma abs_lagrangeFundamental_mul_distance_eq_pair_transport {n : ℕ}
    (nodes : NodeFamily n) {j k : Fin n} (hjk : j ≠ k) {t : ℝ}
    (ht : ∀ i : Fin n, t ≠ nodes.point i) :
    |lagrangeFundamental nodes k t| * |t - nodes.point k| =
      |lagrangeFundamental nodes j t| *
        |(lagrangeBasis nodes k).derivative.eval (nodes.point j)| *
          |nodes.point j - nodes.point k| * |t - nodes.point j|

name: Erdos1153.ClassicalBound.clockGap_pos
statement:
lemma clockGap_pos {n : ℕ} (nodes : OrderedNodes n) (g : Fin (n - 1)) :

name: Erdos1153.ClassicalBound.clockLeftIndex_lt_rightIndex

name: Erdos1153.ClassicalBound.sq_card_div_two_le_sum_inv_of_sum_le_two

lemma sq_card_div_two_le_sum_inv_of_sum_le_two {m : ℕ}

name: Erdos1153.ClassicalBound.le_stepGeometricWeight_of_le_scale
statement:
lemma le_stepGeometricWeight_of_le_scale {m r : ℕ} (scale : Fin m → ℝ)

    (i : Fin (m - r)) :
    a ≤ stepGeometricWeight scale i

name: Erdos1153.ClassicalBound.mul_sq_sub_div_mul_length_le_stepPairEnergy
statement:
theorem mul_sq_sub_div_mul_length_le_stepPairEnergy {m r : ℕ}
    (x scale : Fin m → ℝ) (hx : StrictMono x) (hr : 0 < r) (hrm : r < m)
    {A B h a : ℝ} (hxIcc : ∀ i, x i ∈ Set.Icc A B)
    (hh : 0 < h) (hinterval : B - A ≤ h) (ha : 0 ≤ a)
    (hscale : ∀ i, a ≤ scale i) :
    a * ((((m - r : ℕ) : ℝ) ^ 2) / ((r : ℝ) * h)) ≤
      stepPairEnergy (r := r) x scale

name: Erdos1153.ClassicalBound.mul_sum_sq_sub_div_mul_length_le_localPairEnergy
statement:
theorem mul_sum_sq_sub_div_mul_length_le_localPairEnergy {m : ℕ}
    (x scale : Fin m → ℝ) (hx : StrictMono x)
    {A B h a : ℝ} (hxIcc : ∀ i, x i ∈ Set.Icc A B)
    (hh : 0 < h) (hinterval : B - A ≤ h) (ha : 0 ≤ a)
    (hscale : ∀ i, a ≤ scale i) :
    a * (∑ r ∈ Finset.Ico 1 m,
      (((m - r : ℕ) : ℝ) ^ 2) / ((r : ℝ) * h)) ≤
        localPairEnergy x scale

name: Erdos1153.ClassicalBound.sq_sub_div_mul_length_le_sum_stepSpan_inv
statement:
theorem sq_sub_div_mul_length_le_sum_stepSpan_inv {m r : ℕ}
    (x : Fin m → ℝ) (hx : StrictMono x) (hr : 0 < r) (hrm : r < m)
    {A B h : ℝ} (hxIcc : ∀ i, x i ∈ Set.Icc A B)
    (hh : 0 < h) (hinterval : B - A ≤ h) :
    (((m - r : ℕ) : ℝ) ^ 2) / ((r : ℝ) * h) ≤
      ∑ i : Fin (m - r), (stepSpan x i)⁻¹

name: Erdos1153.ClassicalBound.stepLeftIndex_lt_stepRightIndex
statement:
lemma stepLeftIndex_lt_stepRightIndex {m r : ℕ} (hr : 0 < r)

name: Erdos1153.ClassicalBound.sum_stepSpan_eq_boundary
statement:
lemma sum_stepSpan_eq_boundary {m r : ℕ} (x : Fin m → ℝ)
    (hrm : r ≤ m) :
    (∑ i : Fin (m - r), stepSpan x i) =

lemma abs_eval_le_mul_lebesgueOn {n : ℕ} (nodes : NodeFamily n)

statement:

statement:
theorem scale_oscillation {d K : ℕ} {q θ : ℝ}
    (P : HalfArcsinePartition d K q) (i : Fin K)
    (hθ : θ ∈ Set.Icc
      (P.angle (angleBinLeft i)) (P.angle (angleBinRight i))) :
    cosineBinLowerScale d P.angle i ≤ clippedArcsineScale d (Real.cos θ) ∧

statement:
theorem geometricPartition_full_budget_le
    {d K : ℕ} {q : ℝ} (hq : 1 < q)
    (hterminal : 1 ≤ q ^ K * cubicChebyshevFloor d) :
    2 * (∑ i : Fin (K + 1),

statement:

statement:
theorem denseBin_divisor_lower {m L : ℕ} (x scale : Fin m → ℝ)

    {A B h a : ℝ} (hxIcc : ∀ i, x i ∈ Set.Icc A B)
    (hh : 0 < h) (hinterval : B - A ≤ h) (ha : 0 ≤ a)
    (hscale : ∀ i, a ≤ scale i) :
    a * (((((m - m / L : ℕ) : ℝ) ^ 2) * realHarmonic (m / L)) / h) ≤
      localPairEnergy x scale

name: Erdos1153.ClassicalBound.mul_sq_mul_one_sub_div_mul_realHarmonic_div_le_localPairEnergy
statement:
theorem mul_sq_mul_one_sub_div_mul_realHarmonic_div_le_localPairEnergy
    {m R : ℕ} (x scale : Fin m → ℝ) (hx : StrictMono x) (hRm : R < m)
    {A B h a : ℝ} (hxIcc : ∀ i, x i ∈ Set.Icc A B)
    (hh : 0 < h) (hinterval : B - A ≤ h) (ha : 0 ≤ a)
    (hscale : ∀ i, a ≤ scale i) :
    a * (((m : ℝ) ^ 2 * (1 - (R : ℝ) / (m : ℝ)) ^ 2 *
      realHarmonic R) / h) ≤ localPairEnergy x scale

name: Erdos1153.ClassicalBound.mul_sq_sub_mul_realHarmonic_div_le_localPairEnergy

    (hh : 0 < h) (hinterval : B - A ≤ h) (ha : 0 ≤ a)
    (hscale : ∀ i, a ≤ scale i) :
    a * (((((m - R : ℕ) : ℝ) ^ 2) * realHarmonic R) / h) ≤
      localPairEnergy x scale

name: Erdos1153.ClassicalBound.mul_truncatedLengthKernel_le_truncatedLocalPairEnergy
statement:
theorem mul_truncatedLengthKernel_le_truncatedLocalPairEnergy
    {m R : ℕ} (x scale : Fin m → ℝ) (hx : StrictMono x) (hRm : R < m)
    {A B h a : ℝ} (hxIcc : ∀ i, x i ∈ Set.Icc A B)
    (hh : 0 < h) (hinterval : B - A ≤ h) (ha : 0 ≤ a)

name: Erdos1153.ClassicalBound.sq_sum_div_sum_div_le_sum_mul_sq_div
statement:
theorem sq_sum_div_sum_div_le_sum_mul_sq_div
    {ι : Type*} [DecidableEq ι] (bins : Finset ι)
    (mass a h : ι → ℝ)
    (ha : ∀ s ∈ bins, 0 < a s) (hh : ∀ s ∈ bins, 0 < h s) :
    ((∑ s ∈ bins, mass s) ^ 2) /
        (∑ s ∈ bins, h s / a s) ≤
      ∑ s ∈ bins, a s * (mass s) ^ 2 / h s

name: Erdos1153.ClassicalBound.sq_sum_natCount_div_sum_div_le_sum_mul_sq_div
statement:
theorem sq_sum_natCount_div_sum_div_le_sum_mul_sq_div
    {ι : Type*} [DecidableEq ι] (bins : Finset ι)
    (count : ι → ℕ) (a h : ι → ℝ)
    (ha : ∀ s ∈ bins, 0 < a s) (hh : ∀ s ∈ bins, 0 < h s) :
    ((∑ s ∈ bins, (count s : ℝ)) ^ 2) /
        (∑ s ∈ bins, h s / a s) ≤
      ∑ s ∈ bins, a s * (count s : ℝ) ^ 2 / h s

statement:
theorem sq_total_div_sum_div_le_sum_mul_countSq_div

    (hsum : ∑ s : Fin K, count s = n) (a h : Fin K → ℝ)
    (ha : ∀ s, 0 < a s) (hh : ∀ s, 0 < h s) :
    (n : ℝ) ^ 2 / (∑ s : Fin K, h s / a s) ≤
      ∑ s : Fin K, a s * (count s : ℝ) ^ 2 / h s

name: Erdos1153.ClassicalBound.sub_div_le_sum_denseCounts
statement:
theorem sub_div_le_sum_denseCounts {K n : ℕ} (hK : 0 < K)

    (sparse : Finset (Fin K))
    (hsparse : ∀ s ∈ sparse,
      (count s : ℝ) ≤ (n : ℝ) / (K : ℝ) ^ 2) :
    (n : ℝ) - (n : ℝ) / (K : ℝ) ≤
      ∑ s ∈ (Finset.univ \ sparse), (count s : ℝ)

    (hterminal : 1 ≤ q ^ K * cubicChebyshevFloor d)

    nodes.point (arcsineNodeBinEmbedding q hterminal nodes b i) ∈
      geometricSignedBinInterval d q b

name: Erdos1153.ClassicalBound.dense_arcsineBin_divisor_lower
statement:
theorem dense_arcsineBin_divisor_lower
    {d K n L : ℕ} {q : ℝ} (hd : 1 ≤ d) (hq : 1 < q)
    (hterminal : 1 ≤ q ^ K * cubicChebyshevFloor d)
    (nodes : OrderedNodes n) (b : Bool × Fin (K + 1))
    (hL : 1 < L) (hLm : L ≤ arcsineNodeBinCount q hterminal nodes b) :
    geometricBinLowerScale d q b.2 *
        (((((arcsineNodeBinCount q hterminal nodes b -
              arcsineNodeBinCount q hterminal nodes b / L : ℕ) : ℝ) ^ 2) *
            realHarmonic
              (arcsineNodeBinCount q hterminal nodes b / L)) /
          cosineBinLength
            (geometricHalfArcsinePartition d K q hq hterminal).angle b.2) ≤
      arcsineBinLocalEnergy q hterminal nodes b

name: Erdos1153.ClassicalBound.geometricBinLowerScale_le_arcsineNodeBinScale
statement:
theorem geometricBinLowerScale_le_arcsineNodeBinScale
    {d K n : ℕ} {q : ℝ} (hq : 1 < q)
    (hterminal : 1 ≤ q ^ K * cubicChebyshevFloor d)
    (nodes : OrderedNodes n) (b : Bool × Fin (K + 1))
    (i : Fin (arcsineNodeBinCount q hterminal nodes b)) :
    geometricBinLowerScale d q b.2 ≤
      clippedArcsineScale d
        (nodes.point (arcsineNodeBinEmbedding q hterminal nodes b i))

name: Erdos1153.ClassicalBound.geometricSignedBin_intervalLength
statement:
lemma geometricSignedBin_intervalLength
    (d K : ℕ) {q : ℝ} (hq : 1 < q)
    (hterminal : 1 ≤ q ^ K * cubicChebyshevFloor d)
    (b : Bool × Fin (K + 1)) :
    geometricSignedBinUpperEndpoint d q b -
        geometricSignedBinLowerEndpoint d q b =
      cosineBinLength
        (geometricHalfArcsinePartition d K q
          hq hterminal).angle b.2

name: Erdos1153.ClassicalBound.mem_geometricSignedBinInterval_of_assignment
statement:
theorem mem_geometricSignedBinInterval_of_assignment
    {d K : ℕ} {q x : ℝ} (hd : 1 ≤ d) (hq : 1 < q)
    (hterminal : 1 ≤ q ^ K * cubicChebyshevFloor d)
    (hxIcc : x ∈ Set.Icc (-1 : ℝ) 1)
    (b : Bool × Fin (K + 1))
    (hx : x ∈ arcsineAssignedBin d K q hterminal b) :
    x ∈ geometricSignedBinInterval d q b

name: Erdos1153.ClassicalBound.sum_arcsineBinLocalEnergy_le_clippedPairEnergy
statement:
theorem sum_arcsineBinLocalEnergy_le_clippedPairEnergy
    {d K n : ℕ} (q : ℝ)
    (hterminal : 1 ≤ q ^ K * cubicChebyshevFloor d)
    (nodes : OrderedNodes n) :
    (∑ b : Bool × Fin (K + 1),
      arcsineBinLocalEnergy q hterminal nodes b) ≤
        clippedPairEnergy d nodes

name: Erdos1153.ClassicalBound.sum_assignmentFiberLocalEnergy_le_clippedPairEnergy
statement:
theorem sum_assignmentFiberLocalEnergy_le_clippedPairEnergy
    {d n : ℕ} {β : Type*} [Fintype β] [DecidableEq β]
    (nodes : OrderedNodes n) (assign : Fin n → β) :
    (∑ b : β, assignmentFiberLocalEnergy (d := d) nodes assign b) ≤
      clippedPairEnergy d nodes

name: Erdos1153.ClassicalBound.sum_selectedDense_arcsineBin_lower_le_clippedPairEnergy
statement:
theorem sum_selectedDense_arcsineBin_lower_le_clippedPairEnergy
    {d K n L : ℕ} {q : ℝ} (hd : 1 ≤ d) (hq : 1 < q)
    (hterminal : 1 ≤ q ^ K * cubicChebyshevFloor d)
    (nodes : OrderedNodes n)
    (bins : Finset (Bool × Fin (K + 1))) (hL : 1 < L)
    (hdense : ∀ b ∈ bins, L ≤ arcsineNodeBinCount q hterminal nodes b) :
    (∑ b ∈ bins,
      geometricBinLowerScale d q b.2 *
        (((((arcsineNodeBinCount q hterminal nodes b -
              arcsineNodeBinCount q hterminal nodes b / L : ℕ) : ℝ) ^ 2) *
            realHarmonic
              (arcsineNodeBinCount q hterminal nodes b / L)) /
          cosineBinLength
            (geometricHalfArcsinePartition d K q hq hterminal).angle b.2)) ≤
      clippedPairEnergy d nodes

name: Erdos1153.ClassicalBound.card_signedArcsineLabels
statement:
lemma card_signedArcsineLabels (K : ℕ) :
    Fintype.card (Bool × Fin (K + 1)) = 2 * (K + 1)

name: Erdos1153.ClassicalBound.clippedPairEnergy_lower_finite
statement:
theorem clippedPairEnergy_lower_finite
    {d K n T L : ℕ} {q : ℝ}
    (hd : 1 ≤ d) (hq : 1 < q)
    (hterminal : 1 ≤ q ^ K * cubicChebyshevFloor d)
    (nodes : OrderedNodes n) (hL : 1 < L) (hLT : L ≤ T)
    (hBTn : 2 * (K + 1) * T ≤ n) :
    (((n : ℝ) - ((2 * (K + 1) * T : ℕ) : ℝ)) ^ 2 /
        (q * Real.pi)) *
        (1 - (1 : ℝ) / (L : ℝ)) ^ 2 * realHarmonic (T / L) ≤
      clippedPairEnergy d nodes

name: Erdos1153.ClassicalBound.common_dense_harmonicFactor_le
statement:
lemma common_dense_harmonicFactor_le
    {m T L : ℕ} (hL : 1 < L) (hTm : T ≤ m) :
    (m : ℝ) ^ 2 * (1 - (1 : ℝ) / (L : ℝ)) ^ 2 *
        realHarmonic (T / L) ≤
      (((m - m / L : ℕ) : ℝ) ^ 2) * realHarmonic (m / L)

name: Erdos1153.ClassicalBound.mem_denseArcsineLabels
Erdos1153.ClassicalBound.realHarmonic_mono
statement:
lemma realHarmonic_mono {R S : ℕ} (hRS : R ≤ S) :
    realHarmonic R ≤ realHarmonic S

name: Erdos1153.ClassicalBound.sub_binThreshold_le_sum_denseArcsineCounts
statement:
theorem sub_binThreshold_le_sum_denseArcsineCounts
    {d K n T : ℕ} (q : ℝ)
    (hterminal : 1 ≤ q ^ K * cubicChebyshevFloor d)
    (nodes : OrderedNodes n) :
    (n : ℝ) - ((2 * (K + 1) * T : ℕ) : ℝ) ≤
      ∑ b ∈ denseArcsineLabels q hterminal nodes T,
        (arcsineNodeBinCount q hterminal nodes b : ℝ)

name: Erdos1153.ClassicalBound.sum_selected_arcsineBinLength_div_lowerScale_le
statement:
theorem sum_selected_arcsineBinLength_div_lowerScale_le
    {d K : ℕ} {q : ℝ} (hq : 1 < q)
    (hterminal : 1 ≤ q ^ K * cubicChebyshevFloor d)
    (bins : Finset (Bool × Fin (K + 1))) :
    (∑ b ∈ bins,
      cosineBinLength
          (geometricHalfArcsinePartition d K q hq hterminal).angle b.2 /
        geometricBinLowerScale d q b.2) ≤ q * Real.pi

name: Erdos1153.ClassicalBound.eventually_clippedPairEnergy_lower_canonical
statement:
theorem eventually_clippedPairEnergy_lower_canonical
    {q : ℝ} (hq : 1 < q) {R L : ℕ}
    (hR : 1 ≤ R) (hL : 1 < L) {η : ℝ} (hη : 0 < η) :
    ∀ᶠ n : ℕ in atTop, ∀ nodes : OrderedNodes n,
      (((1 - (1 : ℝ) / (R : ℝ)) ^ 2 / (q * Real.pi)) *
          (1 - (1 : ℝ) / (L : ℝ)) ^ 2 * (1 - η)) *
          (n : ℝ) ^ 2 * Real.log (n : ℝ) ≤
        clippedPairEnergy (n - 1) nodes

name: Erdos1153.ClassicalBound.totalBinCount_mul_denseThreshold_le
statement:
lemma totalBinCount_mul_denseThreshold_le
    {n R : ℕ} {q : ℝ} (hR : 1 ≤ R) :
    arcsineTotalBinCount n q * arcsineDenseThreshold n q R ≤ n

name: Erdos1153.ClassicalBound.exists_energy_parameters
statement:
theorem exists_energy_parameters (eps : ℝ) (heps : 0 < eps) :
    ∃ (q : ℝ) (R L : ℕ) (eta : ℝ),
      1 < q ∧ 1 ≤ R ∧ 1 < L ∧ 0 < eta ∧ eta < 1 ∧
      2 * ((1 - (R : ℝ)⁻¹) ^ 2 / (q * Real.pi)) *
          (1 - (L : ℝ)⁻¹) ^ 2 * (1 - eta) >
        2 / Real.pi - eps

name: Erdos1153.ClassicalBound.sum_riesz_midpoint_weights
statement:
theorem sum_riesz_midpoint_weights (d : ℕ) (hd : 0 < d) :
    ∑ j ∈ Finset.range (2 * d),
        1 / (4 * (d : ℝ) *
          Real.sin (((2 * (j : ℝ) + 1) * Real.pi) / (4 * (d : ℝ))) ^ 2) =
      (d : ℝ)

name: Erdos1153.ClassicalBound.rieszRootMoment_center_add
statement:
lemma rieszRootMoment_center_add (d k : ℕ) (hd : 0 < d) (hk : k ≤ d) :
    rieszRootMoment d (d + 1 + k) = (d : ℂ) * k

name: Erdos1153.ClassicalBound.riesz_derivative_formula
statement:
theorem riesz_derivative_formula (d : ℕ) (hd : 0 < d) (p : ℝ[X])
    (hdeg : p.natDegree ≤ d) (θ : ℝ) :
    -Real.sin θ * p.derivative.eval (Real.cos θ) =
      ∑ j ∈ Finset.range (2 * d), rieszSignedWeight d j *
        p.eval (Real.cos (θ + rieszAngle d j))

name: Erdos1153.ClassicalBound.riesz_formula_chebyshevT
statement:
lemma riesz_formula_chebyshevT (d k : ℕ) (hd : 0 < d) (hk : k ≤ d) (θ : ℝ) :
    -Real.sin θ *
        (Polynomial.Chebyshev.T ℝ (k : ℤ)).derivative.eval (Real.cos θ) =
      ∑ j ∈ Finset.range (2 * d), rieszSignedWeight d j *
        (Polynomial.Chebyshev.T ℝ (k : ℤ)).eval
          (Real.cos (θ + rieszAngle d j))

name: Erdos1153.ClassicalBound.root_weighted_bernstein
statement:
theorem root_weighted_bernstein (d : ℕ) (p : ℝ[X])
    (hdeg : p.natDegree ≤ d) (M : ℝ)
    (hbound : ∀ t ∈ Set.Icc (-1 : ℝ) 1, |p.eval t| ≤ M)
    {x : ℝ} (hx : x ∈ Set.Icc (-1 : ℝ) 1) (_hroot : p.eval x = 0) :
    Real.sqrt (1 - x ^ 2) * |p.derivative.eval x| ≤ (d : ℝ) * M

name: Erdos1153.ClassicalBound.sum_abs_rieszSignedWeight
statement:
theorem sum_abs_rieszSignedWeight (d : ℕ) (hd : 0 < d) :
    ∑ j ∈ Finset.range (2 * d), |rieszSignedWeight d j| = (d : ℝ)

name: Erdos1153.ClassicalBound.sum_cos_mul_rieszAngle_eq_zero
statement:
lemma sum_cos_mul_rieszAngle_eq_zero (d m : ℕ) (hd : 0 < d)
    (hm0 : 0 < m) (hm : m < 2 * d) :
    ∑ j ∈ Finset.range (2 * d), Real.cos ((m : ℝ) * rieszAngle d j) = 0

name: Erdos1153.ClassicalBound.sum_rieszPhase_pow_eq_zero
statement:
lemma sum_rieszPhase_pow_eq_zero (d m : ℕ) (hd : 0 < d)
    (hm0 : 0 < m) (hm : m < 2 * d) :
    ∑ j ∈ Finset.range (2 * d), rieszPhase d j ^ m = 0

name: Erdos1153.ClassicalBound.sum_rieszSignedWeight_mul_cos
statement:
lemma sum_rieszSignedWeight_mul_cos (d k : ℕ) (hd : 0 < d) (hk : k ≤ d) :
    ∑ j ∈ Finset.range (2 * d),
      rieszSignedWeight d j * Real.cos ((k : ℝ) * rieszAngle d j) = 0

name: Erdos1153.ClassicalBound.sum_rieszSignedWeight_mul_cos_add
statement:
lemma sum_rieszSignedWeight_mul_cos_add (d k : ℕ) (hd : 0 < d) (hk : k ≤ d)
    (θ : ℝ) :
    ∑ j ∈ Finset.range (2 * d), rieszSignedWeight d j *
      Real.cos ((k : ℝ) * (θ + rieszAngle d j)) =
        -(k : ℝ) * Real.sin ((k : ℝ) * θ)

name: Erdos1153.ClassicalBound.sum_rieszSignedWeight_mul_phase_pow
statement:
lemma sum_rieszSignedWeight_mul_phase_pow (d k : ℕ) (hd : 0 < d) (hk : k ≤ d) :
    ∑ j ∈ Finset.range (2 * d),
      (rieszSignedWeight d j : ℂ) * rieszPhase d j ^ k =
        Complex.I * (k : ℂ)

name: Erdos1153.ClassicalBound.sum_rieszSignedWeight_mul_sin
statement:
lemma sum_rieszSignedWeight_mul_sin (d k : ℕ) (hd : 0 < d) (hk : k ≤ d) :
    ∑ j ∈ Finset.range (2 * d),
      rieszSignedWeight d j * Real.sin ((k : ℝ) * rieszAngle d j) = (k : ℝ)

name: Erdos1153.ClassicalBound.sum_sin_mul_rieszAngle_eq_zero
statement:
lemma sum_sin_mul_rieszAngle_eq_zero (d m : ℕ) (hd : 0 < d)
    (hm0 : 0 < m) (hm : m < 2 * d) :
    ∑ j ∈ Finset.range (2 * d), Real.sin ((m : ℝ) * rieszAngle d j) = 0

name: Erdos1153.ClassicalBound.weighted_bernstein_of_pos
statement:
theorem weighted_bernstein_of_pos (d : ℕ) (hd : 0 < d) (p : ℝ[X])
    (hdeg : p.natDegree ≤ d) (M : ℝ)
    (hbound : ∀ t ∈ Set.Icc (-1 : ℝ) 1, |p.eval t| ≤ M)
    {x : ℝ} (hx : x ∈ Set.Icc (-1 : ℝ) 1) :
    Real.sqrt (1 - x ^ 2) * |p.derivative.eval x| ≤ (d : ℝ) * M

name: Erdos1153.ClassicalBound.pointwiseClippedBernsteinAt
statement:
theorem pointwiseClippedBernsteinAt (d : ℕ) (p : ℝ[X]) (x M : ℝ) :
    PointwiseClippedBernsteinAt d p x M

name: Erdos1153.ClassicalBound.pointwiseClippedBernsteinAt_signedDerivativeRowPolynomial
statement:
theorem pointwiseClippedBernsteinAt_signedDerivativeRowPolynomial
    {n : ℕ} (nodes : OrderedNodes n) (j : Fin n) :
    PointwiseClippedBernsteinAt (n - 1)
      (signedDerivativeRowPolynomial nodes j) (nodes.point j)
      (lebesgueOn nodes.toNodeFamily (-1) 1)

name: Erdos1153.abs_gapCoefficient
statement:
@[simp]
lemma abs_gapCoefficient {n : ℕ} (g : Fin (n - 1)) (k : Fin n) :
    |gapCoefficient g k| = 1

name: Erdos1153.abs_gapSignFactor
statement:
@[simp]
lemma abs_gapSignFactor {n : ℕ} (g : Fin (n - 1)) (k j : Fin n) :
    |gapSignFactor g k j| = 1

name: Erdos1153.abs_lagrangeFundamental_eq_gapCoefficient_mul
Erdos1153.adjacentCommonNode_val
statement:
@[simp]
lemma adjacentCommonNode_val {n : ℕ} (q : Fin (n - 2)) :

name: Erdos1153.closedGap_nonempty
statement:
lemma closedGap_nonempty {n : ℕ} (nodes : OrderedNodes n) (g : Fin (n - 1)) :

name: Erdos1153.degree_gapPolynomial_le
statement:
lemma degree_gapPolynomial_le {n : ℕ} (nodes : OrderedNodes n) (g : Fin (n - 1)) :
    (gapPolynomial nodes g).degree ≤ (n - 1 : ℕ)

name: Erdos1153.exists_gapCoefficient_eq_neg_one
statement:
lemma exists_gapCoefficient_eq_neg_one {n : ℕ} (hn : 3 ≤ n) (g : Fin (n - 1)) :
    ∃ k : Fin n, gapCoefficient g k = -1

name: Erdos1153.exists_gapHeight_eq_eval_gapPolynomial
statement:
lemma exists_gapHeight_eq_eval_gapPolynomial {n : ℕ} (nodes : OrderedNodes n)
    (g : Fin (n - 1)) :
    ∃ t ∈ closedGap nodes g,
      gapHeight nodes g = (gapPolynomial nodes g).eval t ∧
        ∀ u ∈ closedGap nodes g,
          (gapPolynomial nodes g).eval u ≤ (gapPolynomial nodes g).eval t

name: Erdos1153.gapCoefficient_add_adjacent
statement:
lemma gapCoefficient_add_adjacent {n : ℕ} (q : Fin (n - 2)) (k : Fin n) :
    gapCoefficient (lowerAdjacentGap q) k +
        gapCoefficient (upperAdjacentGap q) k =
      if k = adjacentCommonNode q then 2 else 0

name: Erdos1153.gapCoefficient_eq_one_or_neg_one
statement:
lemma gapCoefficient_eq_one_or_neg_one {n : ℕ} (g : Fin (n - 1)) (k : Fin n) :
    gapCoefficient g k = 1 ∨ gapCoefficient g k = -1

name: Erdos1153.gapCoefficient_left
statement:
@[simp]
lemma gapCoefficient_left {n : ℕ} (g : Fin (n - 1)) :

name: Erdos1153.gapCoefficient_mul_lagrangeFundamental_nonneg
Erdos1153.gapCoefficient_mul_lagrangeFundamental_pos
Erdos1153.gapCoefficient_ne_zero
statement:
lemma gapCoefficient_ne_zero {n : ℕ} (g : Fin (n - 1)) (k : Fin n) :

name: Erdos1153.gapCoefficient_of_le
statement:
lemma gapCoefficient_of_le {n : ℕ} (g : Fin (n - 1)) (k : Fin n)
    (hkg : k.val ≤ g.val) :
    gapCoefficient g k = (-1 : ℝ) ^ (g.val - k.val)

name: Erdos1153.gapCoefficient_of_lt
statement:

name: Erdos1153.gapCoefficient_right
statement:
@[simp]
lemma gapCoefficient_right {n : ℕ} (g : Fin (n - 1)) :
    gapCoefficient g (gapRightIndex g) = 1

name: Erdos1153.gapCoefficient_right_eq_neg_left_of_ne
statement:
lemma gapCoefficient_right_eq_neg_left_of_ne {n : ℕ}
    (g h : Fin (n - 1)) (hhg : h ≠ g) :
    gapCoefficient g (gapRightIndex h) =

name: Erdos1153.gapLeftIndex_val
statement:

lemma gapLeftIndex_val {n : ℕ} (g : Fin (n - 1)) :

name: Erdos1153.gapPolynomial_add_adjacent
statement:
lemma gapPolynomial_add_adjacent {n : ℕ} (nodes : OrderedNodes n)
    (q : Fin (n - 2)) :
    gapPolynomial nodes (lowerAdjacentGap q) +
        gapPolynomial nodes (upperAdjacentGap q) =
      Polynomial.C 2 * lagrangeBasis nodes.toNodeFamily (adjacentCommonNode q)

name: Erdos1153.gapPolynomial_eval_eq_sum
statement:
lemma gapPolynomial_eval_eq_sum {n : ℕ} (nodes : OrderedNodes n)
    (g : Fin (n - 1)) (t : ℝ) :
    (gapPolynomial nodes g).eval t =
      ∑ k : Fin n, gapCoefficient g k *
        lagrangeFundamental nodes.toNodeFamily k t

name: Erdos1153.gapPolynomial_eval_left
statement:
@[simp]
lemma gapPolynomial_eval_left {n : ℕ} (nodes : OrderedNodes n) (g : Fin (n - 1)) :

name: Erdos1153.gapPolynomial_eval_node
statement:
lemma gapPolynomial_eval_node {n : ℕ} (nodes : OrderedNodes n) (g : Fin (n - 1))
    (k : Fin n) :

name: Erdos1153.gapPolynomial_eval_right
statement:
@[simp]
lemma gapPolynomial_eval_right {n : ℕ} (nodes : OrderedNodes n) (g : Fin (n - 1)) :
    (gapPolynomial nodes g).eval (nodes.point (gapRightIndex g)) = 1

name: Erdos1153.gapRightIndex_val
statement:
@[simp]
lemma gapRightIndex_val {n : ℕ} (g : Fin (n - 1)) :
    (gapRightIndex g).val = g.val + 1

name: Erdos1153.gapSignFactor_eq_one_or_neg_one
statement:
lemma gapSignFactor_eq_one_or_neg_one {n : ℕ} (g : Fin (n - 1)) (k j : Fin n) :
    gapSignFactor g k j = 1 ∨ gapSignFactor g k j = -1

name: Erdos1153.gapSignFactor_mul_div_nonneg
statement:
lemma gapSignFactor_mul_div_nonneg {n : ℕ} (nodes : OrderedNodes n)
    (g : Fin (n - 1)) {k j : Fin n} (hjk : j ≠ k) {t : ℝ}
    (ht : t ∈ closedGap nodes g) :
    0 ≤ gapSignFactor g k j *
      ((t - nodes.point j) / (nodes.point k - nodes.point j))

name: Erdos1153.gapSignFactor_mul_div_pos
statement:
lemma gapSignFactor_mul_div_pos {n : ℕ} (nodes : OrderedNodes n)
    (g : Fin (n - 1)) {k j : Fin n} (hjk : j ≠ k) {t : ℝ}
    (ht : t ∈ openGap nodes g) :
    0 < gapSignFactor g k j *
      ((t - nodes.point j) / (nodes.point k - nodes.point j))

name: Erdos1153.gap_left_lt_right
statement:
lemma gap_left_lt_right {n : ℕ} (nodes : OrderedNodes n) (g : Fin (n - 1)) :

name: Erdos1153.lebesgueFunction_eq_eval_gapPolynomial
statement:
lemma lebesgueFunction_eq_eval_gapPolynomial {n : ℕ} (nodes : OrderedNodes n)
    (g : Fin (n - 1)) {t : ℝ} (ht : t ∈ closedGap nodes g) :

    rightBoundaryAmplification nodes q ≤
      ∏ j ∈ Finset.univ.erase k,
        |(rightBoundaryMidpoint nodes q - nodes.point j) /

      ∀ δ : ℝ, |δ| < η → ∀ z ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1,
        ∀ k : Fin (d + 2),
          |spec.exteriorRatio δ k

      ∀ δ : ℝ, 0 < δ → δ < η → ∀ z ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1,
        |spec.fullCardinal δ k

          lagrangeFundamental spec.pattern.toNodeFamily k z| < ε

name: Erdos1153.DeBoorPinkus.coordinateCriticalMap_fderiv_vertical
statement:
lemma coordinateCriticalMap_fderiv_vertical {d : ℕ} {A B : ℝ}
    (hAB : AdmissibleInterval A B)
    (u : {v : Fin d → ℝ // v ∈ endpointNodeSpace d A B})
    (g : Fin (d + 1)) (x : ℝ) :
    (fderiv ℝ (coordinateCriticalMap A B g) (u.1, x)).comp
        (ContinuousLinearMap.inr ℝ (Fin d → ℝ) ℝ) =
      ContinuousLinearMap.smulRight (1 : ℝ →L[ℝ] ℝ)
        ((coordinateGapPolynomial A B u.1 g).derivative.derivative.eval x)

statement:
lemma coordinateCriticalValue_eq {d : ℕ} {A B : ℝ}

statement:
lemma coordinateGapHeight_eq_value_at_argmax {d : ℕ} {A B : ℝ}

name: Erdos1153.DeBoorPinkus.coordinateGapPartialPolynomial_eq_sourceSensitivity
statement:
lemma coordinateGapPartialPolynomial_eq_sourceSensitivity {d : ℕ}
    {A B : ℝ} (hAB : AdmissibleInterval A B)
    (u : {v : Fin d → ℝ // v ∈ endpointNodeSpace d A B})
    (g : Fin (d + 1)) (j : Fin d) :
    coordinateGapPartialPolynomial A B u.1 g j =
      C (-(coordinateGapPolynomial A B u.1 g).derivative.eval
        (endpointPoint A B u.1 (interiorNodeIndex j))) *
        coordinateLagrangePolynomial A B u.1 (interiorNodeIndex j)

name: Erdos1153.DeBoorPinkus.coordinateGapPartialPolynomial_eval_node
statement:
lemma coordinateGapPartialPolynomial_eval_node {d : ℕ} {A B : ℝ}
    (hAB : AdmissibleInterval A B)
    (u : {v : Fin d → ℝ // v ∈ endpointNodeSpace d A B})
    (g : Fin (d + 1)) (j : Fin d) (k : Fin (d + 2)) :
    (coordinateGapPartialPolynomial A B u.1 g j).eval
        (endpointPoint A B u.1 k) =
      -(coordinateNodeVelocity j k) *
        (coordinateGapPolynomial A B u.1 g).derivative.eval
          (endpointPoint A B u.1 k)

lemma coordinateGapPolynomial_eq {d : ℕ} {A B : ℝ}

name: Erdos1153.DeBoorPinkus.coordinateGapValueMap_fderiv_horizontal_explicit
statement:
lemma coordinateGapValueMap_fderiv_horizontal_explicit {d : ℕ}
    {A B : ℝ} (hAB : AdmissibleInterval A B)
    (u : {v : Fin d → ℝ // v ∈ endpointNodeSpace d A B})
    (g : Fin (d + 1)) (j : Fin d) (x : ℝ) :
    fderiv ℝ (coordinateGapValueMap A B g) (u.1, x)
        (coordinateDirection j, 0) =
      (coordinateGapPartialPolynomial A B u.1 g j).eval x

name: Erdos1153.DeBoorPinkus.coordinateGapValueMap_fderiv_horizontal_source
statement:
lemma coordinateGapValueMap_fderiv_horizontal_source {d : ℕ}
    {A B : ℝ} (hAB : AdmissibleInterval A B)
    (u : {v : Fin d → ℝ // v ∈ endpointNodeSpace d A B})
    (g : Fin (d + 1)) (j : Fin d) (x : ℝ) :
    fderiv ℝ (coordinateGapValueMap A B g) (u.1, x)
        (coordinateDirection j, 0) =
      -(coordinateGapPolynomial A B u.1 g).derivative.eval
          (endpointPoint A B u.1 (interiorNodeIndex j)) *
        (coordinateLagrangePolynomial A B u.1
          (interiorNodeIndex j)).eval x

name: Erdos1153.DeBoorPinkus.coordinateGapValueMap_fderiv_vertical
statement:
lemma coordinateGapValueMap_fderiv_vertical {d : ℕ} {A B : ℝ}
    (hAB : AdmissibleInterval A B)
    (u : {v : Fin d → ℝ // v ∈ endpointNodeSpace d A B})
    (g : Fin (d + 1)) (x : ℝ) :
    (fderiv ℝ (coordinateGapValueMap A B g) (u.1, x)).comp
        (ContinuousLinearMap.inr ℝ (Fin d → ℝ) ℝ) =
      ContinuousLinearMap.smulRight (1 : ℝ →L[ℝ] ℝ)
        (coordinateCriticalValue A B u.1 g x)

name: Erdos1153.DeBoorPinkus.coordinateLagrangeCriticalFormula_eq
statement:
lemma coordinateLagrangeCriticalFormula_eq {d : ℕ} (A B : ℝ)

name: Erdos1153.DeBoorPinkus.coordinateLagrangeFactorPolynomial_eval
statement:
lemma coordinateLagrangeFactorPolynomial_eval {d : ℕ} (A B : ℝ)

name: Erdos1153.DeBoorPinkus.coordinateLagrangePolynomial_eq
statement:
lemma coordinateLagrangePolynomial_eq {d : ℕ} {A B : ℝ}
    (hAB : AdmissibleInterval A B)
    (u : {v : Fin d → ℝ // v ∈ endpointNodeSpace d A B})
    (k : Fin (d + 2)) :
    coordinateLagrangePolynomial A B u.1 k =
      lagrangeBasis (endpointArrayOfInterior hAB u).toNodeFamily k

name: Erdos1153.DeBoorPinkus.coordinateLagrangePolynomial_eval_eq_prod_factor
statement:
lemma coordinateLagrangePolynomial_eval_eq_prod_factor {d : ℕ}
    (A B : ℝ) (u : Fin d → ℝ) (k : Fin (d + 2)) (x : ℝ) :
    (coordinateLagrangePolynomial A B u k).eval x =
      ∏ i ∈ Finset.univ.erase k,
        coordinateLagrangeFactorValue A B u k i x

name: Erdos1153.DeBoorPinkus.coordinateNodalValue_eq_mul_erase
statement:
lemma coordinateNodalValue_eq_mul_erase {d : ℕ} (A B : ℝ)
    (u : Fin d → ℝ) (j : Fin d) (x : ℝ) :
    coordinateNodalValue A B u x =
      (x - endpointPoint A B u (interiorNodeIndex j)) *
        ∏ k ∈ Finset.univ.erase (interiorNodeIndex j),
          (x - endpointPoint A B u k)

name: Erdos1153.DeBoorPinkus.deletedRowMinor_gapHeightJacobianModel
statement:
theorem deletedRowMinor_gapHeightJacobianModel {d : ℕ} {A B : ℝ}
    (nodes : EndpointArray d A B) (omitted : Fin (d + 1)) :
    deletedRowMinor (gapHeightJacobianModel nodes) omitted =
      (∏ i : Fin d, gapJacobianRowFactor nodes (omitted.succAbove i)) *
        deletedRowMinor (gapQuotientEvaluationMatrix nodes) omitted *
          ∏ j : Fin d, gapJacobianColumnFactor nodes j

name: Erdos1153.DeBoorPinkus.deletedRowMinor_gapHeightJacobianModel_ne_zero_iff
statement:
theorem deletedRowMinor_gapHeightJacobianModel_ne_zero_iff {d : ℕ}

    (omitted : Fin (d + 1)) :
    deletedRowMinor (gapHeightJacobianModel nodes) omitted ≠ 0 ↔
      deletedRowMinor (gapQuotientEvaluationMatrix nodes) omitted ≠ 0

name: Erdos1153.DeBoorPinkus.endpointPoint_coordinateShift
statement:
lemma endpointPoint_coordinateShift {d : ℕ} (A B : ℝ)
    (u : Fin d → ℝ) (j : Fin d) (k : Fin (d + 2)) (s : ℝ) :
    endpointPoint A B (coordinateShift u j s) k =
      endpointPoint A B u k + s * coordinateNodeVelocity j k

name: Erdos1153.DeBoorPinkus.endpointPoint_sub_ne_zero
statement:
lemma endpointPoint_sub_ne_zero {d : ℕ} {A B : ℝ}

      -(gapPolynomial nodes.toOrderedNodes g).derivative.eval

    (hAB : AdmissibleInterval A B)
    (u : {v : Fin d → ℝ // v ∈ endpointNodeSpace d A B})
    (j : Fin d) (x : ℝ) :
    lagrangeFundamental (endpointArrayOfInterior hAB u).toNodeFamily
        (interiorNodeIndex j) x =

    (hlocal : TailHeightLocalOrientationStatement d A B)
    {K : Set (Fin d → ℝ)} (hK : IsCompact K) (a b : ℝ)
    (nodes : ℕ → EndpointArray d A B)
    (hnodes : ∀ n, nodes n ∈ tailHeightSlab K a b) :
    ∃ limit ∈ tailHeightSlab K a b, ∃ phi : ℕ → ℕ,
      StrictMono phi ∧ Tendsto (nodes ∘ phi) atTop (𝓝 limit)

name: Erdos1153.DeBoorPinkus.exists_decreasingRay_to_firstDifference_of_homeomorphism_of_localOrientation
statement:
theorem exists_decreasingRay_to_firstDifference_of_homeomorphism_of_localOrientation
    {d : ℕ} {A B : ℝ} (hd : 1 ≤ d)
    (hhomeomorph : GapDifferenceHomeomorphismStatement d A B)
    (hlocal : TailHeightLocalOrientationStatement d A B)
    (r : EndpointArray d A B) (c : ℝ)
    (hc : c < gapDifference r ⟨0, hd⟩) :
    ∃ alpha : ℝ, 0 < alpha ∧
      ∃ g : C(I, EndpointArray d A B),
        g 0 = r ∧
        (∀ v i, tailGapHeight (g v) i =
          tailGapHeight r i - (v : ℝ) * alpha) ∧
        gapDifference (g 1) ⟨0, hd⟩ = c

name: Erdos1153.DeBoorPinkus.exists_increasingSegment_lift_of_homeomorphism_of_localOrientation
statement:
theorem exists_increasingSegment_lift_of_homeomorphism_of_localOrientation
    {d : ℕ} {A B : ℝ} (hd : 1 ≤ d)
    (hhomeomorph : GapDifferenceHomeomorphismStatement d A B)
    (hlocal : TailHeightLocalOrientationStatement d A B)
    (s : EndpointArray d A B) (y : Fin d → ℝ)
    (hle : ∀ i, tailGapHeight s i ≤ y i)
    (hne : y ≠ tailGapHeight s) :
    ∃ g : C(I, EndpointArray d A B),
      g 0 = s ∧
      (∀ u i, tailGapHeight (g u) i =
        (1 - (u : ℝ)) * tailGapHeight s i + (u : ℝ) * y i) ∧
      StrictAnti (fun u : I ↦
        (g u).height (0 : Fin (d + 1)))

name: Erdos1153.DeBoorPinkus.exists_local_decreasingDiagonal_lift
statement:
theorem exists_local_decreasingDiagonal_lift
    {d : ℕ} {A B : ℝ} (hd : 1 ≤ d)
    (hlocal : TailHeightLocalOrientationStatement d A B)
    (nodes : EndpointArray d A B) (alpha : ℝ) (halpha : 0 < alpha)
    (hzmem : (fun i ↦ tailGapHeight nodes i - alpha) ∈
      ((hlocal.2 hd nodes).some).chart.target) :
    ∃ g : C(I, EndpointArray d A B),
      g 0 = nodes ∧
      (∀ u i, tailGapHeight (g u) i =
        tailGapHeight nodes i - (u : ℝ) * alpha) ∧
      StrictMono (fun u : I ↦
        (g u).height (0 : Fin (d + 1)))

name: Erdos1153.DeBoorPinkus.exists_local_increasingSegment_lift
statement:
theorem exists_local_increasingSegment_lift
    {d : ℕ} {A B : ℝ} (hd : 1 ≤ d)
    (hlocal : TailHeightLocalOrientationStatement d A B)
    (nodes : EndpointArray d A B) (z : Fin d → ℝ)
    (hzle : ∀ i, tailGapHeight nodes i ≤ z i)
    (hzmem : z ∈ ((hlocal.2 hd nodes).some).chart.target)
    (hzNe : z ≠ tailGapHeight nodes) :
    ∃ g : C(I, EndpointArray d A B),
      g 0 = nodes ∧
      (∀ u, tailGapHeight (g u) =
        tailLine (tailGapHeight nodes) z u) ∧
      StrictAnti (fun u : I ↦
        (g u).height (0 : Fin (d + 1)))

name: Erdos1153.DeBoorPinkus.exists_prefixLift_of_isLocalHomeomorph_of_seqCompact
statement:
theorem exists_prefixLift_of_isLocalHomeomorph_of_seqCompact
    {E X : Type*} [TopologicalSpace E] [TopologicalSpace X]
    [T2Space E] [T2Space X]
    {f : E → X} {gamma : ℝ → X} {e0 : E} {T : ℝ}
    (hloc : IsLocalHomeomorph f) (hgamma : Continuous gamma)
    (hT : 0 ≤ T) (hzero : f e0 = gamma 0)
    {K : Set E} (hK : IsSeqCompact K)
    (hendpoint : ∀ {u : ℝ}, u ∈ Set.Icc 0 T →
      ∀ L : PrefixLift f gamma e0 u, L u ∈ K) :
    Nonempty (PrefixLift f gamma e0 T)

name: Erdos1153.DeBoorPinkus.exists_stopped_decreasingRay_of_prefix_endpoint_le
statement:
theorem exists_stopped_decreasingRay_of_prefix_endpoint_le
    {d : ℕ} {A B : ℝ} (hd : 1 ≤ d)
    (hhomeomorph : GapDifferenceHomeomorphismStatement d A B)
    (r : EndpointArray d A B) (c : ℝ)
    (hc : c < gapDifference r ⟨0, hd⟩)
    {u : ℝ} (hu : 0 ≤ u)
    (L : PrefixLift
      (tailGapHeight : EndpointArray d A B → Fin d → ℝ)
      (decreasingTailRay (tailGapHeight r)) r u)
    (hend : gapDifference (L u) ⟨0, hd⟩ ≤ c) :
    ∃ alpha : ℝ, 0 < alpha ∧
      ∃ g : C(I, EndpointArray d A B),
        g 0 = r ∧
        (∀ v i, tailGapHeight (g v) i =
          tailGapHeight r i - (v : ℝ) * alpha) ∧
        gapDifference (g 1) ⟨0, hd⟩ = c

statement:
theorem increasingSegment_lift_range_subset_tailHeightSlab
    {d : ℕ} {A B : ℝ} (s : EndpointArray d A B)

    (hgzero : g 0 = s)
    (hgtail : ∀ u i, tailGapHeight (g u) i =

      (g u).height (0 : Fin (d + 1)))) :

lemma gapDifferenceCombination_eval_node {n : ℕ} (nodes : OrderedNodes n)

name: Erdos1153.Density.abs_equiBasisValue_eq
statement:
lemma abs_equiBasisValue_eq {u v t : ℝ} {d i : ℕ} (hd : 0 < d)
    (huv : u < v) (hi : i ≤ d) :
    |equiBasisValue u v d i t| =
      (∏ j ∈ (Finset.range (d + 1)).erase i,
        |t - equiNode u v d j|) /
      (((v - u) / (d : ℝ)) ^ d *
        ((i.factorial : ℝ) * ((d - i).factorial : ℝ)))

name: Erdos1153.Density.abs_equiBasisValue_le_choose
statement:
lemma abs_equiBasisValue_le_choose {u v t : ℝ} {d i : ℕ}
    (hd : 0 < d) (hu : -1 ≤ u) (huv : u < v) (hv : v ≤ 1)
    (ht : t ∈ Set.Icc (-1 : ℝ) 1) (hi : i ≤ d) :
    |equiBasisValue u v d i t| ≤
      (((2 : ℝ) * d / (v - u)) ^ d / (d.factorial : ℝ)) *
        (d.choose i : ℝ)

name: Erdos1153.Density.abs_equiBasisValue_le_factorial
statement:
lemma abs_equiBasisValue_le_factorial {u v t : ℝ} {d i : ℕ}
    (hd : 0 < d) (hu : -1 ≤ u) (huv : u < v) (hv : v ≤ 1)
    (ht : t ∈ Set.Icc (-1 : ℝ) 1) (hi : i ≤ d) :
    |equiBasisValue u v d i t| ≤
      (2 : ℝ) ^ d /
        (((v - u) / (d : ℝ)) ^ d *
          ((i.factorial : ℝ) * ((d - i).factorial : ℝ)))

name: Erdos1153.Density.abs_eval_le_growthBase_pow_mul_polyMaxIcc
statement:
theorem abs_eval_le_growthBase_pow_mul_polyMaxIcc
    (p : ℝ[X]) {u v t : ℝ}

name: Erdos1153.Density.equiNode_sub_equiNode
statement:

name: Erdos1153.Density.exists_fixedInterval_growthBase
statement:
theorem exists_fixedInterval_growthBase {u v : ℝ}
    (hu : -1 ≤ u) (huv : u < v) (hv : v ≤ 1) :
    ∃ C : ℝ, 1 < C ∧ ∀ p : ℝ[X],
      polyMaxIcc p (-1) 1 ≤ C ^ p.natDegree * polyMaxIcc p u v

name: Erdos1153.Density.exists_polyMaxIcc_eq_and_ge
statement:
lemma exists_polyMaxIcc_eq_and_ge (p : ℝ[X]) {u v : ℝ} (huv : u ≤ v) :
    ∃ x ∈ Set.Icc u v,
      polyMaxIcc p u v = |p.eval x| ∧
        ∀ y ∈ Set.Icc u v, |p.eval y| ≤ |p.eval x|

name: Erdos1153.Density.prod_abs_equiNode_sub_eq
statement:

name: Erdos1153.Density.prod_abs_sub_equiNode_le_two_pow
statement:
lemma prod_abs_sub_equiNode_le_two_pow {u v t : ℝ} {d i : ℕ}

statement:

name: Erdos1153.Density.sum_abs_equiBasisValue_le_growthBase
statement:
lemma sum_abs_equiBasisValue_le_growthBase {u v t : ℝ} {d : ℕ}

name: Erdos1153.Density.abs_dampedPolynomial_eval_le
statement:
lemma abs_dampedPolynomial_eval_le {Q : ℝ[X]} {a b xstar t : ℝ} {d : ℕ}
    (ha : -1 ≤ a) (hab : a < b) (hb : b ≤ 1)
    (hx : xstar ∈ Set.Icc (j0Left a b) (j0Right a b))
    (hxmax : polyMaxIcc Q (j0Left a b) (j0Right a b) = |Q.eval xstar|)
    (hxne : Q.eval xstar ≠ 0) (ht : t ∈ Set.Icc (-1 : ℝ) 1)
    (hout : t ∉ Set.Icc (j1Left a b) (j1Right a b)) :
    |(dampedPolynomial Q xstar d).eval t| ≤
      dampingRho a b ^ d *
        fixedIntervalGrowthBase (j0Left a b) (j0Right a b) ^ Q.natDegree

    (hout : t ∉ Set.Icc (j1Left a b) (j1Right a b)) :
    |(dampingFactor xstar).eval t| ≤ dampingRho a b

name: Erdos1153.Density.abs_eval_mul_inv_le_growthBase_pow
statement:
lemma abs_eval_mul_inv_le_growthBase_pow (Q : ℝ[X])
    {u v xstar t : ℝ} (hu : -1 ≤ u) (huv : u < v) (hv : v ≤ 1)
    (hxmax : polyMaxIcc Q u v = |Q.eval xstar|) (hxne : Q.eval xstar ≠ 0)
    (ht : t ∈ Set.Icc (-1 : ℝ) 1) :
    |Q.eval t * (Q.eval xstar)⁻¹| ≤ fixedIntervalGrowthBase u v ^ Q.natDegree

name: Erdos1153.Density.abs_sparseDampedPolynomial_eval_node_le
statement:
lemma abs_sparseDampedPolynomial_eval_node_le {n : ℕ} (nodes : NodeFamily n)
    {a b xstar : ℝ} (ha : -1 ≤ a) (hab : a < b) (hb : b ≤ 1)
    (hx : xstar ∈ Set.Icc (j0Left a b) (j0Right a b))
    (hxmax : polyMaxIcc (sparsePolynomial nodes a b) (j0Left a b) (j0Right a b) =
      |(sparsePolynomial nodes a b).eval xstar|)
    (hxne : (sparsePolynomial nodes a b).eval xstar ≠ 0) (i : Fin n) :
    |(sparseDampedPolynomial nodes a b xstar).eval (nodes.point i)| ≤
      dampingRho a b ^ dampingExponent n (sparseIndices nodes a b).card *
        fixedIntervalGrowthBase (j0Left a b) (j0Right a b) ^
          (sparseIndices nodes a b).card

statement:
theorem exists_dampingRho_inv_pow_le_lebesgueFunction {n K e : ℕ}
    (nodes : NodeFamily n) {a b : ℝ}
    (ha : -1 ≤ a) (hab : a < b) (hb : b ≤ 1) (hn : 0 < n)
    (hm : (sparseIndices nodes a b).card ≤ n - 1)
    (hC : fixedIntervalGrowthBase (j0Left a b) (j0Right a b) ≤
      (dampingRho a b)⁻¹ ^ K)
    (hbudget : K * (sparseIndices nodes a b).card + e ≤
      dampingExponent n (sparseIndices nodes a b).card) :
    ∃ t ∈ Set.Icc a b,

Erdos1153.Density.exists_local_lower_bound_of_sparse_or_block
statement:

name: Erdos1153.Density.exists_sparseDampedPolynomial_data
statement:
lemma exists_sparseDampedPolynomial_data {n : ℕ} (nodes : NodeFamily n)
    {a b : ℝ} (ha : -1 ≤ a) (hab : a < b) (hb : b ≤ 1)
    (hm : (sparseIndices nodes a b).card ≤ n - 1) :
    ∃ xstar ∈ Set.Icc (j0Left a b) (j0Right a b),
      (sparseDampedPolynomial nodes a b xstar).eval xstar = 1 ∧
      (sparseDampedPolynomial nodes a b xstar).natDegree ≤ n - 1 ∧
      ∀ i : Fin n,
        |(sparseDampedPolynomial nodes a b xstar).eval (nodes.point i)| ≤
          sparseDecay nodes a b

Erdos1153.Density.exists_uniform_sparse_exponential_cutoff
statement:
theorem exists_uniform_sparse_exponential_cutoff {a b : ℝ}
    (ha : -1 ≤ a) (hab : a < b) (hb : b ≤ 1) :
    ∃ K : ℕ, ∀ {n : ℕ} (nodes : NodeFamily n), 0 < n →
      (sparseIndices nodes a b).card ≤ n - 1 →
      (2 * K + 1) * (sparseIndices nodes a b).card + 2 * (n / 8) ≤ n - 1 →
      ∃ t ∈ Set.Icc a b,
        (dampingRho a b)⁻¹ ^ (n / 8) ≤ lebesgueFunction nodes t

    (hC : fixedIntervalGrowthBase (j0Left a b) (j0Right a b) ≤
      (dampingRho a b)⁻¹ ^ K)
    (hbudget : K * (sparseIndices nodes a b).card + e ≤
      dampingExponent n (sparseIndices nodes a b).card) :
    sparseDecay nodes a b ≤ dampingRho a b ^ e

name: Erdos1153.Density.exists_eventual_target_witness_of_dense
statement:
theorem exists_eventual_target_witness_of_dense
    {a b ε : ℝ} (ha : -1 ≤ a) (hab : a < b) (hb : b ≤ 1)
    (hdense : ∀ K : ℕ,
      fixedIntervalGrowthBase (j0Left a b) (j0Right a b) ≤
          (dampingRho a b)⁻¹ ^ K →
        ∃ N₀ : ℕ, ∀ n : ℕ, N₀ ≤ n → ∀ nodes : NodeFamily n,
          DenseAt nodes a b K →
            ∃ t ∈ Set.Icc a b,
              (2 / Real.pi - ε) * Real.log (n : ℝ) <
                lebesgueFunction nodes t) :
    ∃ N : ℕ, 2 ≤ N ∧
      ∀ n : ℕ, N ≤ n → ∀ nodes : NodeFamily n,
        ∃ t ∈ Set.Icc a b,
          (2 / Real.pi - ε) * Real.log (n : ℝ) <
            lebesgueFunction nodes t

statement:
theorem exists_sparse_target_or_dense {a b ε : ℝ}
    (ha : -1 ≤ a) (hab : a < b) (hb : b ≤ 1) :
    ∃ K N : ℕ, 4 ≤ N ∧
      fixedIntervalGrowthBase (j0Left a b) (j0Right a b) ≤
        (dampingRho a b)⁻¹ ^ K ∧
      ∀ n : ℕ, N ≤ n → ∀ nodes : NodeFamily n,
        (∃ t ∈ Set.Icc a b,
          (2 / Real.pi - ε) * Real.log (n : ℝ) <
            lebesgueFunction nodes t) ∨
        DenseAt nodes a b K

@[simp]
lemma sorted_endpoint_array {d : ℕ} {A B : ℝ} (s : EndpointArray d A B) :
    s.toNodeFamily.sorted = s.toOrderedNodes

name: JSPFreeNodes.sorted_of_ordered
statement:
@[simp]
lemma sorted_of_ordered {n : ℕ} (s : OrderedNodes n) :
    s.toNodeFamily.sorted = s

name: JSPFreeNodes.sorted_ordered_point
statement:
lemma sorted_ordered_point {n : ℕ} (s : OrderedNodes n) (i : Fin n) :
    s.toNodeFamily.sorted.point i = s.point i

name: JSPFreeNodes.unaffine_affine
statement:
lemma unaffine_affine {A B : ℝ} (hAB : A < B) (t : ℝ) :
    unaffine A B (affine A B t) = t

name: JSPFreeNodes.unaffine_mem_Icc
statement:
lemma unaffine_mem_Icc {A B u v x : ℝ} (hAB : A < B)
    (hx : x ∈ Set.Icc (affine A B u) (affine A B v)) :
    unaffine A B x ∈ Set.Icc u v

name: JSPFreeNodes.value_le_interval_max
statement:
lemma value_le_interval_max {n : ℕ} (nodes : NodeFamily n)
    {a b x : ℝ} (hab : a ≤ b) (hx : x ∈ Set.Icc a b) :
    lebesgueFunction nodes x ≤ lebesgueOn nodes a b

name: JSPFreeNodes.abs_le_scale_mul_lebesgue
statement:
lemma abs_le_scale_mul_lebesgue {d : ℕ} (nodes : NodeFamily (d + 2))
    (a x : ℝ) (ha : ∀ k, |nodes.point k| ≤ a) :
    |x| ≤ a * lebesgueFunction nodes x

name: JSPFreeNodes.allMinPeak_eq_min
statement:
lemma allMinPeak_eq_min {d : ℕ} (nodes : NodeFamily (d + 2)) :
    allMinPeak nodes = min (lebesgueFunction nodes (-1))
      (min (minPeak nodes) (lebesgueFunction nodes 1))

name: JSPFreeNodes.allMinPeak_le
statement:
lemma allMinPeak_le {d : ℕ} (nodes : NodeFamily (d + 2))
    (i : Option (Option (Fin (d + 1)))) :
    allMinPeak nodes ≤ augmentedGapHeight nodes i

name: JSPFreeNodes.allMinPeak_le_internal
statement:
lemma allMinPeak_le_internal {d : ℕ} (nodes : NodeFamily (d + 2)) :
    allMinPeak nodes ≤ minPeak nodes

name: JSPFreeNodes.jsp_000937_one_node
statement: theorem jsp_000937_one_node (nodes : NodeFamily 1) : IsOneNodeFullMaximizer nodes

name: JSPFreeNodes.le_allMinPeak_iff
statement:
lemma le_allMinPeak_iff {d : ℕ} (nodes : NodeFamily (d + 2)) (L : ℝ) :
    L ≤ allMinPeak nodes ↔ ∀ i, L ≤ augmentedGapHeight nodes i

name: JSPFreeNodes.left_exterior_max
statement:
lemma left_exterior_max {d : ℕ} (nodes : NodeFamily (d + 2)) :
    lebesgueOn nodes (-1) (nodes.sorted.point 0) =
      lebesgueFunction nodes (-1)

name: JSPFreeNodes.oneNodeAllMinPeak_eq_one
statement:
lemma oneNodeAllMinPeak_eq_one (nodes : NodeFamily 1) :
    oneNodeAllMinPeak nodes = 1

name: JSPFreeNodes.right_exterior_max
statement:
lemma right_exterior_max {d : ℕ} (nodes : NodeFamily (d + 2)) :
    lebesgueOn nodes (nodes.sorted.point (Fin.last (d + 1))) 1 =
      lebesgueFunction nodes 1

name: JSPFreeNodes.Logarithmic.nodal_polynomial_cardinal_identity
statement:
lemma nodal_polynomial_cardinal_identity {n : ℕ} (hn : 0 < n)
    (nodes : NodeFamily n) (p : ℝ[X]) (hpdeg : p.natDegree = n)
    (hroot : ∀ j, p.eval (nodes.point j) = 0)
    (k : Fin n) (x : ℝ) :
    p.eval x = (x - nodes.point k) *
      p.derivative.eval (nodes.point k) * lagrangeFundamental nodes k x

name: JSPFreeNodes.Logarithmic.harmonicReal_eq
statement: lemma harmonicReal_eq (n : ℕ) : harmonicReal n = (harmonic n : ℝ)

name: JSPFreeNodes.Logarithmic.harmonicReal_le
statement: lemma harmonicReal_le (n : ℕ) : harmonicReal n ≤ 1 + Real.log (n : ℝ)

name: JSPFreeNodes.Logarithmic.sum_le_of_index_distance
statement:
lemma sum_le_of_index_distance {n : ℕ} (p : Fin n) (f : Fin n → ℝ) (K : ℝ)
    (hp : f p ≤ K)
    (hfar : ∀ j : Fin n, j ≠ p →
      f j ≤ 2 / |(j.val : ℝ) - (p.val : ℝ)|) :
    (∑ j : Fin n, f j) ≤ K + 4 * harmonicReal n

name: JSPFreeNodes.Logarithmic.angle_distance_le_sine
statement:
lemma angle_distance_le_sine (θ φ : ℝ)
    (hθ : θ ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) Real.pi)
    (hφ : φ ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) Real.pi) :
    |θ - φ| ≤ Real.pi * |Real.sin ((θ - φ) / 2)|

name: JSPFreeNodes.Logarithmic.sin_mul_distance_le_pi_mul_cos_distance
statement:
lemma sin_mul_distance_le_pi_mul_cos_distance (θ φ : ℝ)
    (hθ : θ ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) Real.pi)
    (hφ : φ ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) Real.pi) :
    Real.sin φ * |θ - φ| ≤ Real.pi * |Real.cos θ - Real.cos φ|

name: JSPFreeNodes.Logarithmic.abs_derivative_mul_sin_rootAngle
statement:
lemma abs_derivative_mul_sin_rootAngle {n : ℕ} (hn : 0 < n) (j : Fin n) :
    |(T ℝ (n : ℤ)).derivative.eval (Real.cos (rootAngle n j))| *
        Real.sin (rootAngle n j) = (n : ℝ)

name: JSPFreeNodes.Logarithmic.abs_sin_mul_rootAngle
statement:
lemma abs_sin_mul_rootAngle {n : ℕ} (hn : 0 < n) (j : Fin n) :
    |Real.sin ((n : ℝ) * rootAngle n j)| = 1

name: JSPFreeNodes.Logarithmic.cardinal_angular_weighted
statement:
lemma cardinal_angular_weighted {n : ℕ} (hn : 0 < n) (j : Fin n) (θ : ℝ)
    (hθ : θ ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) Real.pi) :
    |lagrangeFundamental (chebyshevNodes n hn) j (Real.cos θ)| *
      ((n : ℝ) * |θ - rootAngle n j|) ≤ Real.pi * |Real.cos ((n : ℝ) * θ)|

name: JSPFreeNodes.Logarithmic.cardinal_le_inverse_distance
statement:
lemma cardinal_le_inverse_distance {n : ℕ} (hn : 0 < n) (j : Fin n) (θ : ℝ)
    (hθ : θ ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) Real.pi) (hne : θ ≠ rootAngle n j) :
    |lagrangeFundamental (chebyshevNodes n hn) j (Real.cos θ)| ≤
      Real.pi / ((n : ℝ) * |θ - rootAngle n j|)

name: JSPFreeNodes.Logarithmic.cardinal_le_pi_add_one
statement:
lemma cardinal_le_pi_add_one {n : ℕ} (hn : 0 < n) (j : Fin n) (θ : ℝ)
    (hθ : θ ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) Real.pi) :
    |lagrangeFundamental (chebyshevNodes n hn) j (Real.cos θ)| ≤ Real.pi + 1

name: JSPFreeNodes.Logarithmic.cardinal_weighted_identity
statement:
lemma cardinal_weighted_identity {n : ℕ} (hn : 0 < n) (j : Fin n) (θ : ℝ) :
    |lagrangeFundamental (chebyshevNodes n hn) j (Real.cos θ)| * (n : ℝ) *
      |Real.cos θ - Real.cos (rootAngle n j)| =
        Real.sin (rootAngle n j) * |Real.cos ((n : ℝ) * θ)|

name: JSPFreeNodes.Logarithmic.chebyshevNodes_point
statement:
@[simp] lemma chebyshevNodes_point (n : ℕ) (hn : 0 < n) (j : Fin n) :
    (chebyshevNodes n hn).point j = Real.cos (rootAngle n j)

name: JSPFreeNodes.Logarithmic.chebyshev_derivative_mul_sin
statement:
lemma chebyshev_derivative_mul_sin (n : ℕ) (θ : ℝ) :
    (T ℝ (n : ℤ)).derivative.eval (Real.cos θ) * Real.sin θ =
      (n : ℝ) * Real.sin ((n : ℝ) * θ)

name: JSPFreeNodes.Logarithmic.chebyshev_lebesgueOn_le
statement:
theorem chebyshev_lebesgueOn_le {n : ℕ} (hn : 0 < n) :
    lebesgueOn (chebyshevNodes n hn) (-1) 1 ≤ Real.pi + 1 + 4 * harmonicReal n

name: JSPFreeNodes.Logarithmic.chebyshev_lebesgueOn_log
statement:
theorem chebyshev_lebesgueOn_log {n : ℕ} (hn : 2 ≤ n) :
    lebesgueOn (chebyshevNodes n (by omega)) (-1) 1 ≤
      logConstant * Real.log (n : ℝ)

name: JSPFreeNodes.Logarithmic.chebyshev_lebesgue_cos_le
statement:
theorem chebyshev_lebesgue_cos_le {n : ℕ} (hn : 0 < n) (θ : ℝ)
    (hθ : θ ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) Real.pi) :
    lebesgueFunction (chebyshevNodes n hn) (Real.cos θ) ≤
      Real.pi + 1 + 4 * harmonicReal n

name: JSPFreeNodes.Logarithmic.chebyshev_lebesgue_le
statement:
theorem chebyshev_lebesgue_le {n : ℕ} (hn : 0 < n) (x : ℝ)
    (hx : x ∈ Set.Icc (-1 : ℝ) 1) :
    lebesgueFunction (chebyshevNodes n hn) x ≤ Real.pi + 1 + 4 * harmonicReal n

name: JSPFreeNodes.Logarithmic.chebyshev_natDegree
statement: lemma chebyshev_natDegree (n : ℕ) : (T ℝ (n : ℤ)).natDegree = n

name: JSPFreeNodes.Logarithmic.chebyshev_root
statement:
lemma chebyshev_root {n : ℕ} (hn : 0 < n) (j : Fin n) :
    (T ℝ (n : ℤ)).eval ((chebyshevNodes n hn).point j) = 0

name: JSPFreeNodes.Logarithmic.cos_bound_by_root_distance
statement:
lemma cos_bound_by_root_distance {n : ℕ} (hn : 0 < n) (j : Fin n) (θ : ℝ) :
    |Real.cos ((n : ℝ) * θ)| ≤ (n : ℝ) * |θ - rootAngle n j|

name: JSPFreeNodes.Logarithmic.cos_mul_rootAngle
statement:
lemma cos_mul_rootAngle {n : ℕ} (hn : 0 < n) (j : Fin n) :
    Real.cos ((n : ℝ) * rootAngle n j) = 0

name: JSPFreeNodes.Logarithmic.logConstant_pos
statement: lemma logConstant_pos : 0 < logConstant

name: JSPFreeNodes.Logarithmic.nearest_index_separation
statement:
lemma nearest_index_separation {n : ℕ} (hn : 0 < n) (θ : ℝ) (p : Fin n)
    (hp : ∀ j, |θ - rootAngle n p| ≤ |θ - rootAngle n j|) (j : Fin n) :
    |(j.val : ℝ) - (p.val : ℝ)| * (Real.pi / (n : ℝ)) ≤
      2 * |θ - rootAngle n j|

name: JSPFreeNodes.Logarithmic.rootAngle_mem
statement:
lemma rootAngle_mem {n : ℕ} (hn : 0 < n) (j : Fin n) :
    rootAngle n j ∈ Set.Ioo (0 : ℝ) Real.pi

name: JSPFreeNodes.Logarithmic.rootAngle_mem_closed
statement:
lemma rootAngle_mem_closed {n : ℕ} (hn : 0 < n) (j : Fin n) :
    rootAngle n j ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) Real.pi

name: JSPFreeNodes.Logarithmic.rootAngle_strictMono
statement:
lemma rootAngle_strictMono {n : ℕ} (hn : 0 < n) :
    StrictMono (rootAngle n)

name: JSPFreeNodes.Logarithmic.rootAngle_sub
statement:
lemma rootAngle_sub (n : ℕ) (i j : Fin n) :
    rootAngle n i - rootAngle n j =
      ((i.val : ℝ) - (j.val : ℝ)) * (Real.pi / (n : ℝ))

name: JSPFreeNodes.Logarithmic.sin_rootAngle_pos
statement:
lemma sin_rootAngle_pos {n : ℕ} (hn : 0 < n) (j : Fin n) :
    0 < Real.sin (rootAngle n j)

name: JSPFreeNodes.canonical_allMinPeak_eq_one
statement:
theorem canonical_allMinPeak_eq_one {d : ℕ} (opt : EndpointArray d (-1) 1) :
    allMinPeak opt.toNodeFamily = 1

name: JSPFreeNodes.one_le_internal_minPeak
statement:
lemma one_le_internal_minPeak {d : ℕ} (nodes : NodeFamily (d + 2)) :
    1 ≤ minPeak nodes

name: Erdos1153.target_of_orderedTarget
statement: theorem target_of_orderedTarget (hordered : OrderedTarget) : Target
